map.动能定理（本页代码口径）：W=½×m×(v₂²−v₁²)（J，m 质量 kg、v: Work-energy theorem (as implemented here): W = ½×m×(v₂²−v₁²) (J, m mass kg, v₁/v₂ initial and final speed m/s), i.e. the net external work equals the change in kinetic energy; linked values: final kinetic energy = ½×m×v₂², initial kinetic energy = ½×m×v₁² (J). Validation: no strict validation; blank values fall back to 0. Criteria: no fixed grading; when v₂ > v₁ W is positive (work added), otherwise negative.
